description: This PHP class handles the transformation of width/height length attributes into CSS styles within the HTMLPurifier library. It converts numeric length attributes to pixel units and prepends them as inline CSS styles.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Length
classes.description: A class for transforming length attributes such as width and height into CSS styles, appending units when necessary.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the attribute name and CSS property name.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the specified attribute into a CSS style, appending 'px' if the value is purely numeric.
